11245_3_39830.t: Le devoilement des tableaux mistiques de l'antiquité, ou paroist la crisologie qui traite de la genealogie du fils du soleil. Des principes de la nature en general, et particulierement du premier qui est l'Esprit Universel du monde
11245_3_39830.n: Leaves numbered 1-117. ; In three parts. On fol. 1: Premier livre de Guillaume de Paris, fol. 28: Livre second de guillaume de paris. fol. 81: Troisième livre de G. de Paris. ; The source for this manuscript could not be found; under the genuine works of William of Auvergne (Guillaume de Paris, Bishop of Paris, d. 1319) is nothing related to alchemy, nor could a work ascribed to him be related to this text. There probably is another 'Guillaume de Paris': at the end of the second book it is stated that 'il vivait 1450' . However, the bishop, builder of the Notre Dame in Paris, is associated with alchemy by later adepts. A Guillaume de Paris is mentioned by Bernardus Trevisanus (Opuscule tres-exellent, Antwerp 1567) and there is a Latin manuscript in the BN in Paris under this name: Epistola Guillelmi Parisiensis episcopi super alkimia (Ms. 7147) -- Information provided by Bibliotheca Phiosophica Hermetica. ; Inscription on fly leaf: Ce manuscript ma cousté cinq cent ... le vingt six Juillet 1705 ...
